note: Three separate grass sites within 900 m of one another on the east flank of Big Mountain; the agency warns for each that the access 'has some sharp turns and waterbars which may prove challenging for some trailers or large RVs'. CV001 is an open grass lot about 25 m by 55 m alongside Big Mountain Road, half a mile from Crawford Trail and in sight of the road. CV003 Northcraft A is a narrow grass strip a short way up an unnamed haul road off Northcraft Road, secluded, the smallest of the three (listed as 55 by 25 ft); the ground climbs about 11% from the road. CV023 Northcraft B is a grass opening about 15 m by 25 m just above Northcraft Road, 0.08 mile from Hook Road; the bank between road and opening is steep, about 20% on the elevation model. All grass, so soft after rain. The way in from Clear Ridge Road is Millers Corner Road and Hook Road; from Chaneysville, Ragged Mountain Road. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: All three site pages re-read: CV001, CV003, CV023 listed and bookable online, Drive-In, max vehicle length 30 ft each (a 23-ft motorhome fits on paper with 7 ft to spare). CV003 and CV023 list only 'RV Site, Tent Site' (no Trailer Site). Access warning quoted in the note. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; booking/hookups/season confirmed; pull_through false (CV001 parallel, the other two back-in); facilities none. Imagery: CV001 a clear grass lot with the pin in it; CV003 a narrow strip ~20 m south-west of the pin under bare canopy; CV023 an opening with the pin on its south-east corner. Spacing 584 m, 421 m, 884 m: no split. NHD: nothing within 200 m.
flags: Access warning on all three (kept, in the note): CV001 'Access road has some sharp turns and waterbars which may prove challenging for some trailers or large RV's. Grass parking lot that will hold 2 camper trailers or 3 vehicles with tents. Site is visible from roadway.'; CV003 'Located off Northcraft Road a short distance back an unnamed haul road. Secluded but access has some sharp turns and waterbars which may prove challenging for some trailers or large RV's. Grass parking lot that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents.'; CV023 'Located on Northcraft Road, Clearville, 0.08 miles from Hook Road. Access road has some sharp turns and waterbars ... Site is a somewhat secluded grass opening that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents.' Not one of the recipe's drop phrases (no 4WD, no 'not recommended', no 'small RV'); a 23-ft Class C is not a large RV. The neighbouring CV002 Big Mountain Landing carries 'not recommended for camper trailers' and is not in the entry.
Equipment categories: CV003 and CV023 list 'RV Site, Tent Site' only (no 'Trailer Site'); CV001 lists all three. An RV category is present on each, so nothing to drop.

GIS vs booking page, CV003: the DCNR GIS layer (2022) has TrailerAccess 'No' and NumberVehicles 0 for CV003 while its own description says 'will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents'; ReserveAmerica sells it as a 30-ft RV site. Booking page stands. CV001 and CV023: TrailerAccess Yes.

Grades (all three pages say 'Driveway Grade: Slight'): 3DEP straight-line profiles - CV023: 459.5 m at the pin, 455.3 m at 24 m, 451.4 m at 40 m toward Northcraft Road (about 20%; the 80-ft driveway may angle across the bank); CV003: 461.1 m at the pin, 451.9 m at 80 m north toward the road (about 11% along a 280-ft haul road); CV001: level with Big Mountain Road. The 3DEP figures are straight lines, not surveyed driveway grades. Figures in the note. CV023's 20% is the one to look at before booking.
Thin length margin: all three are capped at 30 ft, and CV003's listed site is 55 x 25 ft. Fits a 23-ft motorhome on the page; no caveat beyond the note's size remark.
